title: Brew and Haggle
summary: V haggles with a tea stall owner by the canal bridge in Little China while Viktor sits and says nothing.

start.bringUp: Viktor invites V to a tea stall by the canal bridge in Little China, where the prices are a matter of opinion.

variations.know: A different tea, and a tasting before the haggle.
Closing time, and it is raining.
Misty's copy joins and predicts what V will pick.

stall.name: the tea stall by the canal bridge

stages.label: V haggles over the price of two cups of tea
stages.know: Viktor sits at the stall and stays silent. The stall owner is a boxing fan. You haggle for a price at or under sixty percent of the asking price.
stages.wants: V to get the tea for at or under sixty percent of the asking price, or at least to make a deal.

deal.memory: You haggled over two cups of tea by the canal bridge in Little China, and Viktor let you do it alone.

no-deal.memory: You and Viktor walked away from the tea stall without a deal, and he said the tea was still overpriced.
